test_IkSolver_with_pose: test the IkSolver with a Sawyer arm and sampled target poses using linear and angular tolerances
test_IkSolver_solution_found_last_attemp: test that IkSolver returns correct qpos even when the final attempt fails to converge
test_IkSolver_nullspace_reference_valida: test that IkSolver raises ValueError when the nullspace reference array has the wrong length
test_IkSolver_initial_joint_configuratio: test that IkSolver raises ValueError when the initial joint configuration array has the wrong length
test_IkSolver_impossible_target: test that IkSolver returns None when given a target pose outside the robot workspace
